# Batty

> Batty is a native macOS terminal multiplexer built on libghostty, with an agent-facing CLI and MCP server.

Agents running in a Batty Pane can drive Batty through the `batty` command or the `batty mcp` server: open Sessions, Panes and Tabs, show status, run dev servers, and set Reminders. Start with the agent docs, which cover detecting Batty and setting it up for each coding agent.

## Docs

- [Agent docs](https://batty.sstools.co/docs/index.md): detect Batty, CLI and MCP setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
- [CLI reference](https://batty.sstools.co/docs/cli/index.md): every batty command and flag
- [capabilities.json](https://batty.sstools.co/docs/cli/capabilities.json): machine-readable CLI surface
